items.title: ChatGPT shared links enabled account takeover
items.oneliner: Researchers say one shared ChatGPT link could hijack an authenticated session. AI app security debt is now user-facing.

items.title: VOLTA malware uses LLMs for triage
items.oneliner: Cisco found infostealer malware using LLMs to rank victims by value. Attackers are automating post-exploitation economics.

items.title: Firefox is shrinking the patch gap
items.oneliner: Mozilla says AI now finds bugs at researcher speed, so Firefox moved to weekly updates to outrun automated exploiters.

items.title: Linux MPTCP bug risks remote code execution
items.oneliner: Go's security team warned CVE-2026-98432 can expose MPTCP servers to RCE. Kernel patching just became more urgent.

items.title: Turnstile now has a browserless solver
items.oneliner: A Rust library solves Cloudflare Turnstile without headless browsers. Bot defenses are becoming cheaper to bypass.

items.title: AT Protocol data is more public
items.oneliner: Bluesky-style PDS data can expose feeds, app activity, and messages. Decentralization is not the same as privacy.

items.title: Meta's Books3 torrenting claim got sharper
items.oneliner: A former Meta researcher testified he torrented Books3 at work. AI training data provenance is heading for court.

items.title: Prospero targets lean local coding agents
items.oneliner: Prospero ships as a lightweight coding harness for local models and subagents. Agent tooling is moving off the browser.

items.title: Ghostman offers a local-first Postman alternative
items.oneliner: Ghostman launches as a keyboard-first API client with YAML storage and webhook inspection. Dev tools are getting lighter.

items.title: Cisco is funding an AI rewrite push
items.oneliner: Cisco gave one engineer unlimited AI tokens to rewrite 98 percent of legacy code in two years. Cost controls are loosening.
